question: Kalidas Samman is a prestigious arts award presented annually by the government of ________.
solution:
The correct answer is **Madhya Pradesh**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kalidas Samman** is a prestigious arts award in India.
 
• It is presented annually by the government of **Madhya Pradesh**.
 
• The award honors individuals for their outstanding contribution to the fields of Classical Music, Classical Dance, Theatre and Plastic Arts.
 
• It was instituted in the year **1980**.
 
• Recipients of the award receive a cash prize, a plaque, and a citation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 Field
 Description
 
 
 
 

 Classical Music
 Honoring excellence in the field of traditional Indian music.
 
 

 Classical Dance
 Acknowledging mastery in Indian classical dance forms.
 
 

 Theatre
 Recognizing outstanding contributions to Indian theatre.
 
 

 Visual Arts
 Appreciating excellence in the field of visual arts, including painting and sculpture.
